context: 2026-09-29 EAT cycle — Council Signal / Council City measurement framework. Colorado SB 24-205 (AI chatbot transparency) advances through state rulemaking with a machine-readable marking and audit-obligation trajectory. This seed provides the dated timeline a compliance officer needs and maps it to the verified measurement credential.
body: Colorado SB 24-205 requires AI chatbots deployed in the state to disclose synthetic-content provenance with machine-readable markings, and to maintain audit-accessible measurement logs. The rulemaking timeline: initial proposal (2025-Q2), public comment (2026-Q1), draft rule (2026-07-10), final adoption projected 2026-12-01, effective 2027-01-15. The compliance path is not a one-time certification; it is continuous, signed measurement — exactly the Council of AI framework. Monitored containment means the deployer's board of evidence is continuously audited (14 axes, 19+ models, Ed25519-signed manifests), not that the system is statically isolated. The verified measurement credential ties each transparency claim (synthetic-content provenance, denial-score, containment-index reference) to the frozen manifest under which it was observed. Language lock binds: monitored containment (measurement continuously audited, never a false isolation claim) and verified measurement credential (observation tied to manifest, not vendor assertion). Public framing: Council of AI / Council Signal ONLY. Internal measurement axes and model identifiers are never inserted into public copy.
